laws.k: domestic-workers|LB|Unified Standard Contract for Migrant Domestic Workers
laws.t: Unified Standard Contract for Migrant Domestic Workers
laws.tp: Contract terms required for the work permit; a 2020 revision was suspended.
laws.s2: Syarat kontrak yang diperlukan untuk izin kerja. Revisi tahun 2020 ditangguhkan.

coded.vl: Excluded from labor law; terms set by contract or sponsorship only
coded.n: Labour Code art. 7 excludes domestic workers; terms set by the Unified Standard Contract and the sponsorship system. A 2020 revised contract was suspended by the Shura Council.
coded.src: Labour Code 1946 art. 7; Unified Standard Contract 2009

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
coded.n: Standard contract required for the work permit.

coded.vl: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
coded.n: 24 hours' weekly rest, usually spent at the employer's home.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.n: No binding rule; the 2020 contract provision is suspended.

coded.vl: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
coded.n: Accommodation and food by the employer.
Recruitment office rules; fees not prohibited for workers.

coded.vl: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
coded.n: Civil courts and the Ministry of Labour complaints office.

coded.vl: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only

coded.n: No right recognized for domestic workers.

dec.n: Recruitment agencies’ syndicate v. Ministry of Labour (standard contract)
dec.pe: Lebanon adopted a new contract giving domestic workers a weekly day off, limits on hours and the right to resign. Recruitment agencies challenged it, and the top administrative court suspended it.
dec.pi: Lebanon menetapkan kontrak baru yang memberi pekerja rumah tangga hari libur mingguan, batas jam kerja, dan hak mengundurkan diri. Agen perekrut menggugatnya, dan pengadilan tata usaha tertinggi menangguhkannya.
